use crc32fast::Hasher;

fn main() {
    assert_eq!(crc32fast::hash(b"123456789"), 0xcbf4_3926);
    let mut bytes = vec![0u8; 8224];
    let mut random = 0x1234_5678u32;
    for byte in &mut bytes {
        random = random.wrapping_mul(1_664_525).wrapping_add(1_013_904_223);
        *byte = (random >> 24) as u8;
    }
    let mut checksum = 0;
    for offset in [0, 1, 3, 7, 8, 15] {
        for length in [0, 1, 7, 8, 15, 16, 63, 64, 127, 128, 1535, 1536, 1537, 4096, 8192] {
            let input = &bytes[offset..offset + length];
            let mut baseline = Hasher::internal_new_baseline(0, 0);
            baseline.update(input);
            let expected = baseline.finalize();
            assert_eq!(crc32fast::hash(input), expected);
            let mut specialized = Hasher::internal_new_specialized(0, 0).unwrap();
            specialized.update(input);
            assert_eq!(specialized.finalize(), expected);
            let split = length / 2;
            let mut left = Hasher::new();
            left.update(&input[..split]);
            let mut right = Hasher::new();
            right.update(&input[split..]);
            left.combine(&right);
            assert_eq!(left.total_len(), length as u64);
            assert_eq!(left.finalize(), expected);
            checksum ^= expected;
        }
    }
    println!("crc32fast {}", checksum);
}
